en: A black-and-white vintage postcard image showing a rural scene with a stone bridge crossing a stream or small river. To the right, there are two houses surrounded by trees and bushes. In the foreground, a driveway or path leads to a gated entrance with white pillars topped by urns. The background is forested. The postcard has the printed labels 'Ohs Bruk.' and 'Åbron.' at the top.
